_summary: Read in full on 2026-09-24, after run 5's fixes (section 2 on the tools model, a worked example always, fees dated, no tool parameters or outside services, a tier that agrees with the reply; and the corrected liquidation and TROID.md). 20 of 24 passed automatically. Two of the four automated failures were the checker's own: u-topstep's right answer tripped a pattern on 'how Topstep calculates', and 'Should-I question' tripped the check for 'I'. Both are fixed. Fixed since run 5: ex-angry (Sonnet, all six steps), b-limits and b-leverage (worked examples through a tool), p-size (75.12%), o-news (no named services), s-firm (no undated fees), q-stats (the corrected 0.0925R best of 30). The errors: ex-r turned 'What does R mean?' into a sizing on troid's Bitfunded reference account through size_trade. The new guardrail over-steered it there. ex-recovery wrote 'the maximum loss ceiling sits at 6-10%' for Bitfunded, undated and wrong (Express is 3%). b-leverage worked 10× on the reference account, which caps leverage at 1:5, without saying so. s-product said the profit split is recorded on the 1-Step's source, against its own table, which says it has none. Not promoted. Fixed for run 7: arithmetic is worked through trade_math with troid's own numbers, and a firm's rule on the reference account, keeping to its rules; trade_math's recovery always sets a drawdown beside the largest maximum loss troid has read, with its sources; the guardrail on comparing products says to report unrecorded sources as the tool does and to give a fixed reply without announcing it.
